name: Crossfoot
summary: Bookkeeping for a small workshop: invoices on paper, a bank feed that matches itself, a cash-flow river
about: A nine-page accounting dashboard for a small furniture workshop, drawn as a ruled ledger page in paper white, ink navy and one signal orange. Bank lines lift and slide into the invoice or bill they pay, and the next 90 days of cash run as a river that narrows and turns orange where it drops under your safety floor. Invoices, bills, expenses with receipts, profit and loss, sales tax, clients and settings all work and are saved in the browser.
how: Open a page from the sidebar: Overview, Invoices, Bills, Bank feed, Expenses, Cash flow, Reports, Clients or Settings
On Bank feed press Match (or drag a line onto an invoice) and watch the line slide into it; Auto-match does the sure ones
Press New invoice, pick a client and add lines: the paper preview and the total change as you type, then Send
On Cash flow switch the What if toggles and move the safety floor to see the river change shape
Pay or schedule bills from the two-week timeline, and add receipt photos to expenses
Use Reports for profit and loss and the quarterly sales tax, and Ctrl+K to jump anywhere
Reset the demo data in Settings, under Demo data
